newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTUGAL STALWARTS MISSING FOR CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGAL STALWARTS MISSING FOR CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Portugal called up uncapped Sporting defender Roberto 'Beto' Severo on Tuesday to replace central defender Jorge Costa in an injury-depleted 23-man squad for a key World Cup qualifier against Armenia.
Experienced Barcelona goalkeeper Vitor Baia will also be missing for the home match on August 20. His place in goal goes to Rui Correia who plays for Baia's former club Porto.
Baia has been ruled out after damaging tendons in his left knee during his club's pre-season training.
He could be out for two months and miss both of Portugal's remaining matches in qualifying group nine against Germany on September 6 and Northern Ireland on October 11.
The tough-tackling Costa also looks certain to miss Portugal's remaining games after surgery on a leg injury.
Portugal are joint second with Germany in the group, which is led by Ukraine. But the Portuguese have played one more game than the Germans.

Defenders - Sergio Conceicao (Porto), Roberto Severo (Sporting), Paulinho Santos (Porto), Fernando Couto (Barcelona, Spain), Dimas Teixeira (Juventus, Italy), Helder Cristovao (Deportivo Coruna, Spain), Fernando Nelson (Aston Villa, England), Joao Manuel Pinto (Porto)

Midfielders - Rui Barros (Porto), Pedro Martins (Sporting), Pedro Barbosa (Sporting), Paulo Sousa (Borussia Dortmund, Germany), Luis Figo (Barcelona), Daniel Carvalho "Dani" (Ajax Amsterdam, Netherlands), Luis Taira (Salamanca, Spain).

Forwards - Joao Pinto (Benfica), Nuno Gomes (Benfica), Pedro Resende "Pauleta" (Salamanca), Domingos Oliveira (Tenerife, Spain), Hugo Porfirio (Racing Santander, Spain), Rui Costa (Fiorentina, Italy).
